name: ANGELES//2099
thesis: California evolved, not replaced: the San Gabriel Mountains and the LA basin as they are, with a civilisation that grew into them gracefully. Warm, desirable, lived-in. No neon overload, no random spikes.
units: metres; the road sits at Z = 0; the basin floor is far below

road.reference: Angeles Crest Highway (CA-2) character: two lanes cut into granite, guardrail on the drop side, long sweepers and hairpins
road.path: a 600 m sweeping S with one tight hairpin; the valley opens to the south-west so the city sits behind the car in the reveal

downtown.style: slender tapered towers, setbacks, crown halos in warmGold; never twisted spikes

flyingTraffic.rule: lanes follow the grid, never random

blimps.lights: soft band lights, no screens with text

city.note: Downtown sits 9 km from the spur road (the real basin is ~25 km away) and its megatowers reach 1.2-3.0 km: a deliberate, declared exaggeration so a 9:16 reveal reads as gigantic. Bearing, sunset direction and the mountains-above-basin relationship stay true.
city.bearingNote: 230 deg: on the open valley side of the spur road (heading ~221 deg), with the sunset (azimuth 247 deg) behind the skyline.

timeOfDay.rule: one continuous evening: the 25 s piece runs from golden hour to night, driven by the cue sheet's sections
